data.gender_notes: Mueidah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'Auda', meaning to help or support. In Islamic tradition, the name Mueidah represents a guide or helper, often in spiritual matters. The name Mueidah carries the meaning “Guide, Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mueidah usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name signifying guidance and support in spiritual pursuits.
data.etymology: Mueidah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, Helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mueidah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
